items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: Ron Miles who is a beautiful trumpet player. So I booked this thing for eight and a half years... I would play.

ctx.x: He’s on my list to ask you about.

Oh yeah, so all these cats traveling through, plus local guys: Ron Miles who is a beautiful trumpet player. So I booked this thing for eight and a half years, you know, six nights a week I would play. And I’d do the ski season and then I’d do the summer. I mean it was crazy. So that was that period of time, and then right when that ended I got offered to do a solo piano jazz gig at this club in Vail also. And I did that for nine years. So financially things were cool.
Were these fellas, when they came in to sit in with your trio or be booked with your trio, did they bring charts? © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
